fictionNotice: Every firearm in this archive is a fictional MAGIARCHY design. Named real-world firearms are visual and conceptual references only, not licensed copies or products that exist inside the story world.

manufacturer.name: Ren Arms
manufacturer.description: An established Narvean firearms manufacturer based in Rennel, the Ducal capital.
manufacturer.namingTradition: Its pistol models traditionally carry bird nicknames. Each bird broadly corresponds to the physical character, size, role, and perceived personality of the pistol.

weapons.imageAlt: Side profile illustration of the silver and dark Ren L17 Sparrow pistol
weapons.storyUse: Standard-issued pistol for every MSF officer who has passed weapons certification. MSF purchases the Sparrow from Ren Arms and does not manufacture firearms.
weapons.designSummary: A slim silver-and-charcoal pistol built around the older Ren Arms metal-frame language. The brushed silver slide is elongated for its height, with a beveled nose, a long shallow ejection-port cut, a narrow rear serration block, and the RN shield set behind the caliber mark. The dark frame rises into an exposed hammer and a smooth, gently curved backstrap.
characteristics: Brushed silver slide over a dark charcoal frame
Beveled muzzle and gently rounded upper profile
Exposed serrated hammer and low conventional sights
Deeply inset grip panels with broad, smooth palm surfaces
Curved trigger, restrained slide controls, and no external manual safety
Short extended magazine base that adds purchase without changing the narrow silhouette
weapons.modernizationNote: Despite the Sparrow's older design lineage, current-production models omit an external manual safety to reflect the demands and handling priorities of modern combat.
weapons.finishNote: The silver finish is standard to the firearm and is not an MSF customization. Routine issue gradually makes the ordinary Ren Arms product visually associated with MSF officers.
weapons.nameMeaning: Its small size, light visual presence, discretion, and modest chambering.

characterLinks.name: Lynleit
characterLinks.note: Carries the issued Sparrow as her personal sidearm.

weapons.imageAlt: Side profile illustration of the silver and dark Ren L19 Magpie with its optional compensator and extended magazine attached
weapons.familyPosition: Larger, louder, and heavier relative of the Sparrow
weapons.designSummary: An enlarged silver-and-charcoal development of the Sparrow for 9×19 mm. The longer brushed slide, taller dark frame, extended grip, and squared accessory profile give it more mass without abandoning the exposed hammer or the older Ren Arms silhouette. The illustration shows the optional muzzle compensator and extended magazine installed, making the pistol visibly longer in both directions than its base configuration.
characteristics: Brushed silver slide with a long upper relief cut
Exposed serrated hammer and conventional raised sights
Dark charcoal frame with the Sparrow family's curved backstrap and inset grip panels
Restrained slide controls and no external manual safety
Optional squared compensator with two open top ports
Optional extended magazine projecting below the grip for added hand support
weapons.modernizationNote: Despite the Magpie's older design lineage, current-production models omit an external manual safety to reflect the demands and handling priorities of modern combat.
weapons.optionsSummary: Two optional attachments help the compact pistol remain controllable under the stronger recoil of its 9×19 cartridge.

options.name: Attachable compensator
options.effect: Reduces muzzle rise and helps the shooter maintain control under the Magpie's greater recoil.

options.name: Extended magazine
options.effect: Adds gripping surface for firmer recoil control while also increasing ammunition capacity.

weapons.finishNote: It fills the space between a discreet institutional pistol and a full modern duty handgun.
weapons.nameMeaning: Its close relationship to the Sparrow, with a larger, louder, heavier, and more noticeable character.

weapons.imageAlt: Side profile illustration of the compact black Ren L21 Rook with brass-colored barrel, trigger, and controls
weapons.familyPosition: Smallest modern polymer-frame pistol in the family
weapons.storyUse: A common personal purchase for self-defense and a favored private sidearm among style-conscious MSF officers. Felix owns an L21 and later lends it to Lynleit when her continued reliance on the weaker 9×17 Sparrow concerns him.
weapons.designSummary: The Rook is a short, dense 9×19 mm pistol derived from the L24 Crow but reduced in slide, dust-cover, and grip length. Its black polymer frame and dark steel slide keep the mass low, while brass-colored details at the barrel, trigger, slide lock, and magazine release distinguish it from an ordinary service finish. Interlocking diagonal serrations at both ends of the slide give the small pistol a more intricate personal character than the Crow.
characteristics: Short dark steel slide over a compact black polymer frame
Brass-colored barrel visible at the muzzle and through the ejection port
Brass-colored trigger, slide lock, and magazine release
Dense crossed serration fields at the front and rear of the slide
Squared trigger guard with an undercut and a short accessory rail
Extended magazine base that completes the firing grip without giving the pistol Crow-length proportions
weapons.variantNote: Ghost Comp is the Rook's compensated premium configuration, occupying the same conceptual place that a Spectre Comp-style model holds within a micro-compact family.
weapons.finishNote: The smallest modern polymer-frame 9×19 mm pistol on the Narvean market. Its size and chambering support discreet defensive carry, while its brass details and elaborate serrations make it more individual than a standard service gun.
weapons.nameMeaning: A compact, practical, intelligent bird with more confidence and modern utility than a Sparrow.

characterLinks.name: Felix
characterLinks.note: Owns an L21 as his personal sidearm.

characterLinks.name: Lynleit
characterLinks.note: Later carries Felix's L21 on loan when he objects to her continued reliance on the 9×17 Sparrow.

weapons.imageAlt: Side profile illustration of the black Ren L24 Crow compact duty pistol
weapons.role: Standard compact law-enforcement and military secondary sidearm
weapons.storyUse: The Crow is the preferred default secondary sidearm for Narvean law enforcement and military service. It is widely issued because it is conventional, dependable, and easy to treat as ordinary equipment rather than a specialist selection.
weapons.designSummary: The Crow is the compact workhorse of the modern Ren Arms family and the parent design of the smaller L21 Rook. Its dark steel slide and black polymer frame are longer and taller than the Rook, with simpler parallel serrations, a full compact grip, and neutral metal controls. The proportions remain short enough for concealed and protective work while giving the firing hand more uninterrupted surface than the micro-compact model.
characteristics: Dark charcoal steel slide and black polymer frame
Full compact grip with a textured central panel and sculpted finger channel
Straight parallel serrations at both ends of the slide
Broad central slide flats with an understated caliber mark
Squared undercut trigger guard and short accessory rail
Neutral silver trigger and restrained controls
Flush compact magazine and conventional duty sights
weapons.finishNote: It is the boring default of the current service family: common, dependable, and unremarkable enough to disappear into police and military equipment.
weapons.nameMeaning: Its common, capable, dark, and practical character.

weapons.imageAlt: Side profile illustration of the dark full-size Ren L28 Raven pistol with a bright exposed barrel and blue trigger
weapons.role: Advanced full-size law-enforcement and military service pistol
weapons.storyUse: Police and military officers may request the Raven in place of the standard Crow when they favor better accuracy and performance. Reiner prefers the Raven.
weapons.designSummary: The Raven is the advanced full-size counterpart to the standard Crow. Its long dark slide carries five rounded forward windows that expose the bright barrel, while deep rear serrations, a full-length sculpted grip, and a squared frame give it greater visual weight than the Crow. A blue trigger provides the only vivid accent within an otherwise restrained service finish.
characteristics: Long dark-charcoal slide with broad uninterrupted side flats
Five rounded forward slide windows exposing the bright barrel
Deep straight rear serrations and raised conventional sights
Full-size sculpted grip with finger channels and inset textured panels
Squared trigger guard, extended dust cover, and accessory rail
Blue trigger set against restrained black controls
Flush full-size magazine and a small lanyard loop at the heel
weapons.finishNote: A serious performance-focused service pistol rather than a luxury model. Its barrel windows and blue trigger distinguish an officer-selected upgrade without moving it into the Swan's crafted role.
weapons.nameMeaning: A larger, darker, and more imposing service weapon than the Rook or Crow.

characterLinks.name: Reiner
characterLinks.note: Prefers the Raven over the standard Crow for its accuracy and performance.

weapons.imageAlt: Side profile illustration of the silver, black, and brass-accented Ren L31 Swan luxury long-slide pistol
weapons.familyPosition: Luxury flagship of the Ren Arms pistol family
weapons.designSummary: The Swan is a luxury long-slide, exposed-hammer pistol built around a 2011 and 1911-derived silhouette. A silver slide and upper frame sit over a black grip module, while the brass-colored barrel is visible through a row of elongated side windows and at the muzzle. The extended dust cover, long sight radius, skeletonized controls, flared beavertail, and sculpted frame keep the large pistol narrow and deliberate rather than bulky.
characteristics: Long brushed-silver slide with a row of elongated forward windows
Brass-colored barrel visible through the slide and at the muzzle
Black lower frame with an extended dust cover and accessory rail
Exposed skeletonized hammer, long beavertail, and fitted thumb safety
Lightened trigger and raised precision sights
Deeply textured black grip with sculpted front and rear purchase
Fine rear slide serrations and a polished script model mark
weapons.finishNote: A luxury sidearm outside ordinary standard issue. Its long slide, exposed mechanism, ported presentation, and mixed metal finishes give it a crafted appearance distinct from the modern duty line.
weapons.nameMeaning: Length, grace, refinement, and composure. A Raven remains a full-size duty weapon; a Swan is visibly crafted, controlled, and personal.
